title: Reefer Cargo Services: Tier Admission Scope and Request Lead Times
content:
Reefer Cargo Services is sold in six tiers, and each tier is offered only for particular reefer equipment, particular trade lanes and particular goods. Each tier also fixes a lead time, counted in calendar days ahead of the scheduled departure, and states whether an order arriving inside that lead time can still be taken for a fee. This card records those admission figures for every tier.

## Equipment, lanes and goods per tier

| Tier | Reefer equipment used | Trade lanes on which the tier is offered | Goods the tier carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 20RF and 40RH | every lane listed below | any temperature-controlled cargo |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 20RF and 40RH | every lane listed below | any temperature-controlled cargo |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 20RF and 40RH | Transpacific Eastbound; Asia–US East Coast; Asia–North Europe; Europe–South America East Coast; Intra-Asia | fresh citrus; fresh table grapes; fresh apples; fresh pears; fresh kiwifruit; fresh blueberries |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 40RH only | Europe–South America East Coast; Asia–North Europe; Asia–Mediterranean; Transpacific Eastbound | fresh avocados; fresh bananas; fresh berries; fresh stone fruit; fresh cut flowers |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 20RF and 40RH | every lane listed below | pharmaceuticals; clinical trial supplies; vaccines |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 40RH only | Asia–North Europe; Intra-Asia; Transpacific Eastbound | frozen tuna; frozen seafood; frozen biological samples |

"Every lane" stands for the eight trade lanes of the network: Asia–North Europe, Asia–Mediterranean, Transpacific Eastbound, Asia–US East Coast, Transatlantic Westbound, Intra-Asia, Asia–Middle East/India and Europe–South America East Coast. Where a tier's goods column reads "any temperature-controlled cargo", the tier is not limited to a named commodity list.

## Lead time and late orders per tier

| Tier | Lead time (calendar days before scheduled departure) | Order inside the lead time taken? | Late request fee (USD per service) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 3 | yes | 75.00 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 3 | yes | 75.00 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 10 | no | 0.00 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 7 | yes | 150.00 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 7 | yes | 150.00 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 14 | no | 0.00 |

The lead time is the latest point, expressed as a number of calendar days before the scheduled sailing, at which an order still counts as on time. The middle column shows whether the tier takes an order received inside that period, and the last column is the fee such an order attracts, per service; the two tiers that take no late order show 0.00.

## Points of reading

- **Which tiers can run in a 20-foot reefer?** Standard, Monitored, Cold Treatment and Pharma GDP list 20RF; Controlled Atmosphere and Superfreezer list 40RH alone.
- **Which tiers are offered on Transatlantic Westbound or Asia–Middle East/India?** Only the three tiers marked "every lane": Standard, Monitored and Pharma GDP.
- **Which tier asks for the longest notice?** Superfreezer, at 14 calendar days; Cold Treatment follows at 10.
